Class CustomButton

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane

app.components.CustomButton
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
Direct Known Subclasses:
AuthButton, ImageButton
public class CustomButton extends javafx.scene.layout.StackPane
A custom button element that includes a background. Has methods for changing the colour when the mouse is hovering over.
